title: generate-azure-finops-review parameters
description: All parameters are optional. The monthly scheduled task calls {"operation": "report"}. Scope (subscriptions or management group), cost metric, allocation tags, the project tag (PROJECT_TAG_KEYS) and thresholds are set in the CONFIGURE block of the tool code; the agent can only ask for another project tag for one run (project_tag).

operation.description: report writes five files (offline HTML report, JSON snapshot, findings CSV, cost-by-resource CSV, cost-by-project CSV) and returns links, verdict, headline, KPIs (with the project summary), top actions and coverage. query returns one bounded chat view (no files). self_test writes the complete report from built-in SIMULATED data with no network and no configuration.

view.description: Chat view for operation=query only. projects lists the cost per project (or, with project, that project's top services, resource groups and resources).

limit.description: Maximum rows for operation=query; the answer is also capped to 3,500 bytes (transport_capped=true when rows were dropped).

project.description: Only with operation=query: one project name (case-insensitive; Unallocated is accepted). summary, actions, savings, resources and projects then show that project only; the other views stay whole-environment.

project_tag.description: Tag name that names the project for this run, or up to 5 comma-separated names in priority order (for example Proyecto or Project,CostCenter). Overrides PROJECT_TAG_KEYS and the automatic detection. Empty: use PROJECT_TAG_KEYS, or detect the tag.
